content: Practice trackers (Andante, Instrumentive, Athenify, tuneUPGRADE, Practis) surface history via: streak counters, per-piece time-to-date, per-instrument/technique time splits, and rolling aggregate charts (7-day/30-day/year/all-time). Athenify explicitly tracks time-per-technique to ensure well-rounded practice across skill categories, not just repertoire.
